notes.title: Hotfix pack №1
notes.notes:
-Fixed the dancing legs of the corpses.
-Finally fixed the spawn of duplicate weapons in multiplayer after the death of the player character.
-Fixed inability to get achievements for some endings.
-Fixed inability to get the "Bad ending" achievement.
-Fixed an issue that caused the William Walker model to disappear in the final cut-scene in the "Courtesy Call" level when the checkpoint was loaded.
-The soundtrack of the third co-op mission was enhanced.
-Added additional sounds to the final cut-scene of the "No deals" level

notes.title: Multiplayer hotfix №2
notes.notes:
1. Incorrect display of characters' appearance in multiplayer now finally fixed.
2. Fixed an issue due to which the client got access to the list of server presets, instead of his own.

notes.title: Multiplayer hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Multiplayer hotfix[/b]
1. Fixed a problem with incorrect display of skins of weapons
2. Fixed an issue that could result in duplicates of dropped weapons in multiplayer
3. Fixed an issue due to which money earned in multiplayer was not saved after the end of the session
4. Fixed an issue due to which it was impossible to start the third co-op level

notes.title: Ok, now you CAN complite the first level
notes.notes:
Hello my sweet fans. I heed your pleas and decided to simplify the game a little so that you can enjoy it fully, and not just the first level. So:

1-Now, on the last line of the dialogue, after which enemies will start shooting at you, the big red indicator appears in the lower right screen corner.
2-I modified the dialog widget itself. Now holding the space to skip it works always.
3-Pain relievers and armors now restore HP and Armor as a percentage, rather than a number. You'll understand why this is good.
4-William's HP was increased TWICE at the first level.
5-Bot reaction delay was increased from 0.05ms to 0.3ms. I hope that now every old fart will have time to react to bots and shoot them.
6-You can shoot while sprinting.
7-Some have had strange issues with the wrong choice of localization. In general, the game itself sets the language based on what is selected in your Steam settings. But I still fixed something somewhere.
8-Before the very first "nerves breaking" dialog, a tooltip will appear. I sincerely ask you to read it. PLEASE.
9-Aslo added load from checkpoint button to the pause menu.

[i]If after that there is someone who won't complite the first level, I will definitely hang myself[/i] [b](irony)[/b].
